limitations: The result assumes a stationary isotropic overdamped harmonic active Brownian particle with known propulsion speed and translational diffusivity.
It establishes structural identifiability from exact population moments, not finite-sample estimation error.
It does not cover anisotropic or chiral swimmers, resetting, unknown propulsion calibration, or inertia.
title: Two stationary moments identify rotational diffusion and trapping in an active Brownian particle
